item.title: CyberWatch Newsletter -- 2026-10-01
item.description: SUMMARY FAILED: 1 of 5 item below are NOT summaries. The model was reachable but returned nothing usable (answer had no usable 'howserious'), so those item show unedited NVD text -- vendor changelogs, commit messages and CPE strings. Read them as raw data, and treat this issue as a failed run. Items: CVE-2026-88772, CVE-2026-5430, CVE-2026-76504, CVE-2026-71362, CVE-2026-86950.
